plugins.name: day-at-office
plugins.description: A view from a high office window over the city you search for with /city (Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, London, Paris, New York, Dubai, Singapore, Tokyo or Sydney), with a character at the window and a weather you pick with /weather. The weather grows stronger and the character sadder as the context window fills; a gauge on the right shows context and tokens used.

description: Themes for Claude Code, packaged as mods.
